rules.title: JDBC statement built by concatenation
rules.why: Statement with a concatenated query is textbook SQL injection; PreparedStatement with bound parameters is the fix.
rules.falsePositiveHints: PreparedStatement with ? placeholders and setXxx binding is safe even if the SQL text is built from constants.

rules.title: JPA/Hibernate query built from a variable
rules.why: HQL/JPQL injection is exploitable in the same way as SQL injection and often overlooked because an ORM is in use.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Named (:param) or positional (?1) parameters are safe. Concatenating an ORDER BY column name is still a finding unless allow-listed.

rules.title: Spring Security CSRF protection disabled
rules.why: Disabling CSRF on a cookie-authenticated application allows cross-site state changes.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Legitimate for stateless JWT/bearer APIs that never authenticate via cookies. Confirm the authentication model first.

rules.title: Spring Security permits all requests
rules.why: A permitAll over /** makes the whole application anonymous regardless of other rules.
rules.falsePositiveHints: permitAll on login, static assets, health and error paths is correct. The finding is a broad wildcard, or permitAll ordered before the authenticated matchers.

rules.title: No method-level or HTTP-level authorization found
rules.why: No authorization expressions anywhere means the application relies on obscurity for access control.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Check for a servlet filter or gateway performing the check before concluding.

rules.title: Java native deserialization of external data
rules.why: Java deserialization gadget chains give remote code execution and are widely weaponized.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Deserializing data the app wrote to a trusted store is lower risk. An ObjectInputFilter / look-ahead filter closes it.

rules.title: XML factory used without external-entity hardening
rules.why: Default JAXP settings historically resolve external entities, enabling file disclosure and SSRF.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Closed if setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true) or XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING is set on the same factory. Read the following lines.

rules.title: Expression-language or template evaluation over dynamic input
rules.why: SpEL/OGNL/Groovy evaluation of attacker-influenced strings is remote code execution.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Static, developer-authored expressions are fine. Trace whether any part comes from a request.

rules.title: Password stored with a fast or unsalted hash
rules.why: General-purpose digests are far too fast for password storage; offline cracking is trivial. BCrypt/Argon2/PBKDF2 exist for this.
rules.falsePositiveHints: SHA-256 for a file checksum or HMAC is correct. Only password storage is a finding.

rules.title: Spring Boot Actuator endpoints broadly exposed
rules.why: Exposed actuators leak environment, configuration, heap dumps and in some versions allow shutdown or property mutation.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Acceptable only when the management port is bound to an internal interface and separately protected. Verify the port and security config.

rules.title: Zip/archive entry extracted without path validation (Zip Slip)
rules.why: An archive entry named ../../etc/passwd escapes the extraction directory and overwrites arbitrary files.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Closed if the resolved target path is canonicalized and verified to start with the destination directory. Look for that check.

rules.title: Declared dependencies to inventory for advisory checking
rules.why: Collects the dependency inventory for the Step 4 advisory check.
rules.falsePositiveHints: Not a finding on its own.
